method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly). Leave figures date from 2017.
overview: IBM Consulting is IBM's services arm: business transformation, strategy and technology consulting delivered alongside IBM's own software, hybrid cloud and AI products.

differentiators.text: Consulting sits inside a technology vendor, so strategy and transformation work is often linked to IBM's own software, hybrid-cloud and AI platforms.
differentiators.significance: Strong AI and tech exposure; pure strategy roles are a small part of the business.

employee_support.text: In 2017 IBM expanded paid leave to 20 weeks for birth mothers and 12-14 weeks for fathers and adoptive parents, and added up to $20,000 for adoption or surrogacy.

tradeoffs.text: IBM confirmed a low-single-digit percentage workforce reduction in Q4 2025 while refocusing on software and AI; reports said consulting had struggled and that consulting staff were among those affected earlier in 2025.
tradeoffs.significance: Ask about the stability of the specific consulting team.

unknowns: Current US parental leave, flexibility and return-to-office rules.
